questions.subject: Computer Vision
questions.question: Explain the difference between object detection and semantic segmentation in Computer Vision.
questions.ideal_answer: object detection and semantic segmentation differ in several ways: object detection is object localization and classification (works by bounding box + class prediction) whereas semantic segmentation is pixel-level classification (works by class label for each pixel). object detection is typically used for R-CNN, Fast R-CNN, Faster R-CNN, YOLO, SSD, while semantic segmentation is used for FCN, U-Net, DeepLab, Mask R-CNN. Example demonstrating object detection: IoU, mAP metrics. Example demonstrating semantic segmentation: dice loss, IoU loss.

questions.question: Explain the difference between image augmentation and feature extraction in Computer Vision.
